name: Atombit
blog_profile: Atombit operates through specialized sub-brands (Profusion for data science/AI, Amplify Analytix for analytics) targeting financial services with GenAI-powered customer intelligence solutions. Their methodology centers on hyper-personalization, predictive analytics, and next-best-action decisioning within banking and insurance verticals. Delivery model combines EU and India-based teams for scalable data engineering and AI model deployment. Thought leadership themes emphasize real-time customer data platforms and AI-driven segmentation as competitive differentiators for retail banking transformation.

name: Sovanta
blog_profile: Sovanta occupies a unique niche at the SAP-Qualtrics intersection, building embedded analytics experiences and AI agent workflows within SAP BTP environments. Their methodology emphasizes operational experience (OX) convergence — connecting customer and employee experience data directly into SAP transactional systems for real-time action. Delivery model is DACH-anchored with deep SAP ecosystem certifications. Thought leadership consistently targets enterprise decision-makers in manufacturing and financial services seeking to close the insight-to-action gap within existing SAP landscapes.

name: New Metrics
blog_profile: New Metrics positions as the leading Qualtrics implementation partner for GCC government and public sector CX transformation. Their methodology centers on citizen experience maturity models, national CX index development, and large-scale government feedback programs. Delivery model is GCC-based with deep relationships across Saudi and UAE government entities. Thought leadership themes consistently align to Vision 2030 digital government mandates and public sector experience measurement best practices.

name: Ipsos CX
blog_profile: Ipsos CX leverages its global research infrastructure to deliver CX measurement, benchmarking, and analytics at enterprise scale, often powered by Medallia platform deployments. Their methodology emphasizes econometric modeling of experience ROI, loyalty driver analysis, and cross-industry benchmarking. Delivery model combines global research panels with technology-enabled feedback programs. Thought leadership focuses on connecting CX metrics to financial outcomes and evolving consumer behavior across retail, financial services, and telecommunications.

name: commonFont
blog_profile: commonFont positions as a specialized Qualtrics consulting partner with deep expertise in financial services CX program design and optimization. Their methodology emphasizes experience orchestration, AI agent deployment within Qualtrics, and closed-loop feedback program architecture. Delivery model is US-based with focused vertical expertise in banking, healthcare, and enterprise B2B. Thought leadership themes center on Qualtrics platform maximization, AI-driven experience management, and ROI-driven CX program governance.

name: Higher Oak
blog_profile: Higher Oak is a UK-based Qualtrics Platinum Partner specializing in employee and customer experience program implementation across UK and European enterprises. Their methodology focuses on Qualtrics platform deployment, survey design best practices, and experience program governance. Delivery model is UK/EU-centric with Qualtrics-certified consultants. Prolonged content silence raises questions about current operational focus and market activity level.

name: Lukkap
blog_profile: Lukkap operates as a platform-agnostic CX and EX consultancy with strong presence across Spain and Latin America. Their methodology centers on customer journey mapping, employee experience design, and organizational change management as interconnected transformation levers. Delivery model is consulting-led with offices across Spanish-speaking markets. Thought leadership themes emphasize human-centered experience design, cultural transformation, and journey-based performance improvement without strong technology platform allegiance.

name: Izo
blog_profile: Izo positions as the leading Qualtrics-certified CX consultancy across Iberoamerica, operating in 15+ Spanish-speaking markets with enterprise-grade Voice of Customer program design and digital experience optimization capabilities. Their methodology combines CX strategy consulting with Qualtrics platform implementation and managed services. Delivery model leverages distributed Spanish-speaking teams across Latin America and Spain. Thought leadership themes focus on CX maturity assessment, customer journey analytics, and experience-driven business transformation for enterprise clients.

name: Globant
blog_profile: Globant is a global digital transformation company with CX capabilities housed within its Connected Experiences Studio, one of many specialized studios spanning AI, data, cloud, and engineering. Their methodology positions CX as a component of broader AI-driven digital transformation rather than a standalone discipline. Delivery model leverages massive global engineering teams across Latin America, US, and Europe. Thought leadership is dominated by enterprise AI adoption narratives with CX-specific content secondary to the overarching technology transformation story.

name: GemSeek
blog_profile: GemSeek fue absorbida por Accenture Song. Su propuesta original era analytics de CX con foco en predicción de churn y modelado de lealtad — un enfoque data science-first dentro del espacio CX. Sin actividad independiente desde la adquisición.
